CANOPY PRIVACY POLICY

Effective Date: October 2026

1. DATA COLLECTION
We collect your name and email address when you register an account. We also process prayer requests and volunteer sign-ups submitted voluntarily.

2. DATA STORAGE & SECURITY
Your session data is stored securely using Android local storage protocols. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties.

3. YOUR RIGHTS
You have the right to access, rectify, or request deletion of your personal data at any time through the app settings or by contacting privacy@canopyapp.org.

4. COOKIES & LOCAL STORAGE
We use Android SharedPreferences locally on your device to maintain your login session and application preferences. No third-party tracking cookies or ad trackers are used.

5. CONTACT US
For privacy inquiries, contact us at privacy@canopyapp.org.

CANOPY TERMS & CONDITIONS

1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS
By accessing or using the Canopy app, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

2. COMMUNITY CONDUCT
You agree to use community features (such as prayer requests and small group signups) respectfully. Harassment, hate speech, or inappropriate content is strictly prohibited.

3. DISCLAIMER OF WARRANTIES
Canopy is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All content, logos, and materials are owned by Canopy Community Organization.

REFUND & GIVING POLICY

1. VOLUNTARY CONTRIBUTIONS
All online gifts, tithes, and offerings made through Canopy are voluntary contributions to support community programs.

2. REFUND ELIGIBILITY
If a transaction error or duplicate payment occurs, please submit a refund request within 30 days to support@canopyapp.org with your transaction details.

3. TAX DEDUCTIBILITY
Contributions may be tax-deductible under applicable local tax laws for registered non-profit organizations.

COOKIE & LOCAL DATA POLICY\n\nCanopy uses essential local storage (Android SharedPreferences) solely to save your authentication session and UI preferences locally on your device. We do not use third-party tracking cookies, advertising beacons, or analytics trackers.
